harbor_name: La Conner (Port of Skagit La Conner Marina)
entity_name: Port of Skagit (Port of Skagit County)
notes: Owns and operates La Conner Marina (plus airport and business parks; profile address is the airport in Burlington). EDA EAA in T1.1 ($2.20M). SWINOMISH CASE: the FY2022-round PIDP award 693JF72344040 ($11,073,627) to the Swinomish Indian Tribal Community (UEI M4EWJ7AWAD17) funds a Swinomish Port Authority master plan, boat ramp, commercial pier design and mooring float on tribal lands across the Swinomish Channel; its place of performance is coded WI54880 (Superior, WI). It is not a La Conner Marina project, so the tribe has no row here; the tribal port is a harbor missing from the inventory (T2.1).
